source.name: Global Fishing Watch apparent fishing effort
source.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Global Fishing Watch API terms of use, noncommercial use only)
source.note: Apparent fishing effort: hours in which a neural net classified AIS vessel movement as fishing. Vessels without AIS (or with it switched off) are invisible, and gear types are inferred from vessel registries and movement, so absence of colour is not absence of fishing.
source.subsample: EMPTY seed: no Global Fishing Watch API token (GFW_FISHING_TOKEN) exists yet — GFW_API_KEY is the Global Forest Watch key and the fishing gateway rejects it (401, 2026-09-12). Once the token is stored, regenerate the top cells by hours (< 100 KB) with: python3 -B -m pipeline.fishing --out public/data/fishing.geojson --seed-out public/data/seed/fishing.geojson
